description_en: This project is not a closed table but a living knowledge base. Functions, effects, cases, discoveries, predictions, new answers, and analytic solutions may continue to grow through new questions, curiosities, cases, and derivations.
description_zh: 本项目不是封闭表格，而是活体知识库。函数、效应、案例、发现、预测、新答案、解析解等对象都可以因新的问题、新的好奇、新的案例、新的推导而继续增长。
